units.source: Included Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_0__

An included __TRILIUM_PH_0__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note and an embedded Markdown file, such as a __TRILIUM_PH_2__ attachment, are shown with the same three views as a Markdown note in its own tab (see __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note types with split view__TRILIUM_PH_4__): __TRILIUM_PH_5__ __TRILIUM_PH_6__Source view__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__ __TRILIUM_PH_9__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_10__ and __TRILIUM_PH_11__ __TRILIUM_PH_12__Preview__TRILIUM_PH_13__.

To switch the view, press one of the three buttons in the title row of the include. In a note being edited, the toolbar of the include has the same buttons after __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and its __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_4__ menu has them as __TRILIUM_PH_5__Source view__TRILIUM_PH_6__, __TRILIUM_PH_7__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_8__ and __TRILIUM_PH_9__Preview__TRILIUM_PH_10__.
Until a view is chosen, the include shows the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Preview__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_3__ while __TRILIUM_PH_4__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_5__ is on.

To edit the Markdown, turn on __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_3__ above). The source is edited in the code editor of a Markdown note, and the preview follows the changes as you type. While __TRILIUM_PH_4__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_5__ is off, the source can be read and copied but not changed.

The source has the slash commands and the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and __TRILIUM_PH_1__ note links of a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_3__ note. A note created from the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__ list goes under the included note, or for an embedded file under the note that includes it, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__ uploads the image to that same note.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Word wrap__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Line numbers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ submenus of the __TRILIUM_PH_4__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu change how the source shows, as for code (see __TRILIUM_PH_6__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_7__ above).

As in a Markdown note, the preview scrolls along with the source and highlights the block where the cursor is, and __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__B__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__I__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_9__+__TRILIUM_PH_10__M__TRILIUM_PH_11__ and __TRILIUM_PH_12__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_13__+__TRILIUM_PH_14__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_15__+__TRILIUM_PH_16__X__TRILIUM_PH_17__ format the selection.

In a note being edited, the view is saved with the include, so two includes of the same note can show different views. In a __TRILIUM_PH_0__read-only note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the view can be changed too, until the note is opened again.

While the source shows, and wherever the Markdown can be edited, the include has the height of its box size, or the height it was resized to, so turning __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ on or off keeps its size. Otherwise, as in a read-only note, the preview fits its text up to that height. A __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__ include fits its content instead.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Search in note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ searches the source while it shows, and the preview otherwise.
Drawing canvases__TRILIUM_PH_0__

A drawing canvas is an Excalidraw canvas, like the one of a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note, drawn directly in the text note. It is not a note of its own: the drawing is kept in a __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__attachment__TRILIUM_PH_4__ of the text note and is saved together with the text.

To insert a drawing canvas, open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Insert__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_4__ and choose __TRILIUM_PH_5__ __TRILIUM_PH_6__Drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_7__, above __TRILIUM_PH_8__Mermaid diagram__TRILIUM_PH_9__. It is also available as __TRILIUM_PH_10__Drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_11__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_12__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_13__. The canvas is added empty and editable, in a __TRILIUM_PH_14__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_15__ box with its title hidden, and takes the focus, ready for drawing.

To draw or write over an image, select the image and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Convert image to a drawing canvas__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button of its toolbar. The image is replaced by an editable drawing canvas in a __TRILIUM_PH_3__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_4__ box, with its title hidden and the focus in it. The image sits at its original size in the middle of the canvas, zoomed so that all of it shows, and is locked so that it cannot be selected or moved by accident. While it is locked, the canvas can be zoomed in on the image but not zoomed out past it or scrolled beyond its edges. To move or resize the image anyway, right-click it and choose __TRILIUM_PH_5__Unlock__TRILIUM_PH_6__. The caption of the image is kept, but not its alignment or link. Only an image on its own line can be converted, not one inside a paragraph. Undo brings the image back.

An Excalidraw file (__TRILIUM_PH_0__) attached with __TRILIUM_PH_1__Attach and embed file__TRILIUM_PH_2__, under the __TRILIUM_PH_3____TRILIUM_PH_4__Attach file__TRILIUM_PH_5__ button, becomes a drawing canvas too, in a __TRILIUM_PH_6__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_7__ box titled with the file name. It starts with __TRILIUM_PH_8__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_9__ off, so the drawing shows but cannot be changed until __TRILIUM_PH_10__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_11__ is turned on (see below).

To draw on a canvas that does not have the focus, click it first. The canvas then has the tools, menus and keyboard shortcuts of a Canvas note. The toolbars, the menus and the properties of the selected shapes show only while the canvas has the focus, so elsewhere the drawing reads like a picture in the text.

The mouse wheel and the touchpad scroll the note over a canvas too, as over the text. To zoom, use the zoom buttons of the canvas toolbar. The percentage between them opens a menu with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Zoom to fit__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which shows the whole drawing, and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Reset zoom__TRILIUM_PH_3__. To move around the drawing, use the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__Hand__TRILIUM_PH_6__ tool. The zoom and position are saved with the drawing, so the canvas opens again where it was left, wherever the note is shown. In fullscreen, the mouse wheel moves and zooms the drawing instead.

The canvas keeps the size it was drawn at. In a narrower note, for example on a phone, it shrinks down to three quarters of that size, then scrolls sideways instead. The resize handle shows more or less of the drawing at the same zoom, and __TRILIUM_PH_0__Full__TRILIUM_PH_1__ widens it across the note. Fullscreen has a zoom and position of its own and leaves those of the canvas as they were.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__No tool__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button, first among the tools of the canvas toolbar, leaves the drawing alone: the mouse does nothing on it, and a touch gesture over it scrolls the note instead of drawing on, selecting or moving the drawing. In the mobile layout, a canvas starts with no tool and returns to it whenever it loses the focus, so that the note scrolls over its drawings until a tool is picked. Fullscreen has no use for it: a canvas with no tool switches to the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Selection__TRILIUM_PH_4__ tool as it goes fullscreen.

The canvas toolbar replaces the Excalidraw menu: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Export image__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Find on canvas__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Library__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Help__TRILIUM_PH_7__ are at the end of its __TRILIUM_PH_8__ __TRILIUM_PH_9__More tools__TRILIUM_PH_10__ menu. In fullscreen, the Excalidraw menu shows again. In the mobile layout, the canvas toolbar is in the formatting toolbar at the bottom of the screen, behind the __TRILIUM_PH_11__Canvas ›__TRILIUM_PH_12__ button.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Search in note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ finds the text of the drawing among the results of the note and highlights each result on the canvas, which moves only to show a result outside its view. Inside a canvas, the shortcut of the search, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__F__TRILIUM_PH_5__ on desktop, opens it instead of the Excalidraw search, which stays available as __TRILIUM_PH_6__Find on canvas__TRILIUM_PH_7__.

The changes to the drawing are part of the undo history of the text note (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_1__ above). __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Z__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_7__+__TRILIUM_PH_8__Y__TRILIUM_PH_9__ and the __TRILIUM_PH_10__ __TRILIUM_PH_11__Undo__TRILIUM_PH_12__ and __TRILIUM_PH_13__ __TRILIUM_PH_14__Redo__TRILIUM_PH_15__ buttons of the canvas toolbar undo and redo the last change of the note, in the drawing or in the text.
A new drawing has the background color of the note. A background chosen from the Excalidraw menu replaces it.

To protect a finished drawing from accidental changes, select it and turn off __TRILIUM_PH_0__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in its __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_4__ menu. The drawing then shows as a still picture, at the zoom and position it had, and can no longer be changed, zoomed or moved. To draw again, turn on the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ __TRILIUM_PH_6__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_7__ button at the start of its toolbar, which shows only while __TRILIUM_PH_8__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_9__ is off, or turn __TRILIUM_PH_10__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_11__ back on in the menu.

The box sizes, resizing, the caption and the title work as for an included note, but the toolbar of a drawing leaves the box size and the position to its __TRILIUM_PH_0__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Positioning__TRILIUM_PH_3__ above). A __TRILIUM_PH_4__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_5__ drawing canvas shows its title row alone, without the drawing.

In the desktop layout, Excalidraw keeps its desktop interface however small the box is. In the mobile layout, a narrow or short box switches it to a compact interface. For more room, choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__Full__TRILIUM_PH_1__, or show the title and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__Fullscreen__TRILIUM_PH_4__.

In the compact interface, the buttons for the selection are on a rail at the side of the screen while the canvas has the focus, so they stay in reach wherever the canvas is scrolled: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the properties of the selected shapes or of the chosen tool in a panel at the bottom of the screen, above the formatting toolbar, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Duplicate__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_8__ act on the selected shapes, and __TRILIUM_PH_9__ __TRILIUM_PH_10__Done__TRILIUM_PH_11__ finishes a line or an arrow drawn point by point. The rail shows only the buttons that apply, and leaves when none does. The properties close when the selection is cleared, and open again only with __TRILIUM_PH_12__Edit__TRILIUM_PH_13__. In fullscreen, these buttons are at the bottom of the canvas instead.
Pictures added to the drawing are stored in the same attachment. A converted image is kept as an image attachment of the note instead, named with a generated code.
In a __TRILIUM_PH_0__read-only note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the drawing shows as a still picture too, with a gray box in its place until it is drawn.

On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared page__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the drawing is shown as the same picture, in light or dark colors to match the page. Each change to the drawing saves this picture as an SVG image attachment of the note, also named with a generated code, which the list of attachments shows under __TRILIUM_PH_2__Generated by Trilium__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Limitations__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The Excalidraw shape library is not saved for a drawing canvas.
Outside the editor, for example in a tooltip, when printing or in the list of attachments, the drawing is shown as a picture.

A drawing has no picture for shared pages until its first change, except one converted from an image. Until then, for example for an attached __TRILIUM_PH_0__ file, a shared page shows a link to download the drawing instead.
In Safari, the picture of a drawing on a shared page follows the light or dark appearance of the system rather than the theme chosen on the page.
A copy of a drawing canvas pasted in the same note shares the drawing with the original, zoom and position included. A copy pasted in another note gets a drawing of its own.

Mermaid diagram__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button to create an inline Mermaid diagram. The arrow next to it lists a template for each kind of diagram. The diagram is also available as __TRILIUM_PH_1__Mermaid diagram__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_4__.

This feature is quite similar to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note types and is meant as an alternative to it for simple diagrams. For more complex diagrams, use the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_3__ feature for a dedicated Mermaid note.

A diagram shows in a box like the one of an included note, so it can be resized, given another box size (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__) from its __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_6__ menu or shown in fullscreen, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_7__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_8__.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the start of the diagram's toolbar decides whether its source can be changed. While it is off, the source still shows, but read-only.

The buttons next to it choose what the diagram shows, as for a Mermaid note: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Source view__TRILIUM_PH_2__ for the Mermaid source alone, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_5__ for the source with the diagram next to it, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Preview__TRILIUM_PH_8__ for the diagram alone. Its __TRILIUM_PH_9__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_10__ menu offers the same choice.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Word wrap__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Line numbers__TRILIUM_PH_3__ submenus of its __TRILIUM_PH_4__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu change how the source shows, each with __TRILIUM_PH_6__Auto__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__On__TRILIUM_PH_9__ and __TRILIUM_PH_10__Off__TRILIUM_PH_11__, as for an included code note (see __TRILIUM_PH_12__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_13__ in __TRILIUM_PH_14__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_15__).

A new diagram starts editable, in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Split view__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The diagram updates a moment after you stop typing. If the source has an error, the error shows over the last diagram that worked, which stays dimmed, as in a Mermaid note. On desktop, drag the divider between the source and the diagram to resize them.

A diagram without a chosen view shows the source next to the diagram while it is editable, and the diagram alone otherwise. In a read-only note, the source can never be changed. A read-only note and the AI chat show a diagram in the same box, in the view it was saved with, and with the zoom buttons over the diagram instead of in a toolbar. A __TRILIUM_PH_0__Medium__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full__TRILIUM_PH_3__ diagram also has a __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__Fullscreen__TRILIUM_PH_6__ button there, or over the source in the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Source__TRILIUM_PH_8__ view.

To zoom, use the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and __TRILIUM_PH_1__ buttons of the diagram's toolbar; the zoom level between them resets the zoom. In fullscreen, where the toolbar is hidden, the same buttons show over the diagram. Drag the diagram to move around it, and double-click it to reset the view. The mouse wheel scrolls the note until you click the diagram, and then zooms it.

While the source shows, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Mermaid syntax help__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button at the end of the toolbar opens the help on __TRILIUM_PH_3__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_4__, which links to the Mermaid syntax.

The changes made to the source of a diagram are part of the undo history of the text note, in the order they were made. __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Z__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__Y__TRILIUM_PH_7__ undo and redo them from the source as well as from the text, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_8__Editing an include in place__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in __TRILIUM_PH_10__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_11__.
The source of the diagram stays in the note as a Mermaid code block, so the diagram is exported to Markdown as a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ code block that other applications can show.
Diagrams created in earlier versions keep the view they were saved with, and open editable.
Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to insert a YouTube video, or an audio or video file from its web address, that can be played inside the note. Paste the address, then press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert media__TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_6__. The media is inserted as a link preview in the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_8__ display mode, described in __TRILIUM_PH_9__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_10__. The same action is available as __TRILIUM_PH_11__Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_12__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_13__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_14__.
Horizontal ruler__TRILIUM_PH_0__

This feature will display a horizontal line, generally useful to separate different sections of the text. To do so, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
Alternatively, it's possible to insert a horizontal ruler by typing __TRILIUM_PH_0__.
Page break__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Page breaks provide a way to force the next paragraph or block (table, image, etc.) to be displayed onto the next page when printing (either to a real printer to __TRILIUM_PH_0__when exporting to PDF__TRILIUM_PH_1__).
Page breaks are marked in the editor with the words __TRILIUM_PH_0__Page break__TRILIUM_PH_1__, but they will not actually be shown when printed.
To insert a page break, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the formatting toolbar.

units.source: There are four ways to create one:
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview

units.source: 1. By pasting a URL__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: A link preview is automatically created:
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: By pasting the URL and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Space__TRILIUM_PH_1__. This will create an __TRILIUM_PH_2__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_3__ link preview.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: When at the start of a new paragraph, pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will create a __TRILIUM_PH_2__card__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or an __TRILIUM_PH_4__embed__TRILIUM_PH_5__ for a YouTube video or an audio or video file.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: To undo an automatic link preview, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Z__TRILIUM_PH_3__ immediately afterwards which keeps it as a text link instead. Alternatively, once a link preview was created, click on the link and select __TRILIUM_PH_4__Text__TRILIUM_PH_5__ from the link preview toolbar, which makes a link that reads as the title of the page.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: This automatic conversion can be disabled by going to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and unchecking __TRILIUM_PH_4__Autogenerate link previews__TRILIUM_PH_5__ from the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Features__TRILIUM_PH_7__ section.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: If the link is not accessible to the Trilium server (or the network request fails for any other reason), it will not be converted to a link preview. The address of an audio or video file whose name ends in a known extension, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__, __TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__ or __TRILIUM_PH_3__, becomes an __TRILIUM_PH_4__embed__TRILIUM_PH_5__ all the same.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: A URL is only auto-converted when the pasted text __TRILIUM_PH_0__is__TRILIUM_PH_1__ the URL. Links with a display name (e.g. __TRILIUM_PH_2__Trilium Notes website__TRILIUM_PH_3__) are left as text links.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 1. By pasting a URL

units.source: 2. From the link dialog__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Since v0.107.0, a link preview is created from the same __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog as any other link (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__External links__TRILIUM_PH_3__):
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__, or press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__+__TRILIUM_PH_5__K__TRILIUM_PH_6__, to open the dialog on __TRILIUM_PH_7__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_8__.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Type or paste the address, then pick the preview in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_1__: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Card__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or, for a YouTube video or the address of an audio or video file, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_7__. __TRILIUM_PH_8__Text__TRILIUM_PH_9__ inserts an ordinary link. __TRILIUM_PH_10__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_11__ is not shown when text is selected, since the link then keeps the selected text.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Optionally, type a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to show instead of the page's own title. A __TRILIUM_PH_2__Card__TRILIUM_PH_3__ also offers a __TRILIUM_PH_4__Description__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to show instead of the page's own description.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: When you leave the address field, or paste the address with the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button, Trilium reads the page and fills an empty __TRILIUM_PH_3__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_4__, and the empty __TRILIUM_PH_5__Description__TRILIUM_PH_6__ of a card, with the page's own. A spinner at the end of a field shows that its value is loading; once you type in the field, what you type is kept. Switching __TRILIUM_PH_7__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_8__ to __TRILIUM_PH_9__Card__TRILIUM_PH_10__ fills the __TRILIUM_PH_11__Description__TRILIUM_PH_12__ the same way, without reading the page again.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to confirm. The link appears right away and turns into the preview once Trilium has read the page.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: To keep the dialog from reading the page, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and, in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Features__TRILIUM_PH_5__ section, turn off __TRILIUM_PH_6__Automatically retrieve titles for text links__TRILIUM_PH_7__ (for __TRILIUM_PH_8__Text__TRILIUM_PH_9__) or __TRILIUM_PH_10__Automatically retrieve title and description for icon & text links and cards__TRILIUM_PH_11__ (for __TRILIUM_PH_12__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_13__ and __TRILIUM_PH_14__Card__TRILIUM_PH_15__). Both are on by default. While they are on, Trilium contacts the page as soon as you leave the address field, also for a text link. Inserting an __TRILIUM_PH_16__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_17__ link or a __TRILIUM_PH_18__Card__TRILIUM_PH_19__ reads the page either way, since the preview is built from it.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: Alternatively, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and choose __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link to a web page (with icon)__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link to a web page (as a card)__TRILIUM_PH_5__ (both are also found by __TRILIUM_PH_6__link preview__TRILIUM_PH_7__). Each opens the same dialog on __TRILIUM_PH_8__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_9__, with __TRILIUM_PH_10__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_11__ or __TRILIUM_PH_12__Card__TRILIUM_PH_13__ already picked.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: To turn an existing link into a preview, open its __TRILIUM_PH_0__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog and change __TRILIUM_PH_2__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or pick a display in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Display__TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu of the link's toolbar. Either way, a link whose text differs from its address keeps that text as the title of the preview.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 2. From the link dialog

units.source: 3. From the Insert menu, for audio and video__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 3. From the Insert menu, for audio and video

units.source: Choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Audio/video embed__TRILIUM_PH_2__ from the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert buttons__TRILIUM_PH_4__ menu or the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_6__. Paste the address of a YouTube video, or of an audio or video file, and press __TRILIUM_PH_7__Insert media__TRILIUM_PH_8__ or __TRILIUM_PH_9__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_10__ to insert it as an __TRILIUM_PH_11__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_12__. The __TRILIUM_PH_13__ __TRILIUM_PH_14__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_15__ button at the end of the field replaces its text with the text on the clipboard. This button is shown only where Trilium can read the clipboard: in the desktop app, and in a browser over HTTPS unless access to the clipboard was blocked.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 3. From the Insert menu, for audio and video

units.source: The media is inserted once Trilium has read the address, which can take a few seconds: the title and thumbnail of a YouTube video, or whether a file is audio or video. When the address cannot be read, or is that of a web page rather than of a YouTube video or a media file, an error is shown and the prompt stays open. Opening another note in the meantime cancels the insertion.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 3. From the Insert menu, for audio and video

units.source: 4. By saving browser tabs from the Web Clipper__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 4. By saving browser tabs from the Web Clipper

units.source: When the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Web Clipper__TRILIUM_PH_1__ saves the tabs of a window, each tab becomes an __TRILIUM_PH_2__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_3__ link preview showing the title and favicon the browser displays for it. Because this data comes from the browser, pages behind a login keep their real title, and the Trilium server does not contact the saved pages.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 4. By saving browser tabs from the Web Clipper

units.source: When __TRILIUM_PH_0__Autogenerate link previews__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is turned off, the tabs are saved as a list of text links instead.
units.context: Link Previews > Inserting a link preview > 4. By saving browser tabs from the Web Clipper

units.source: Altering an existing link preview__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview

units.source: Click on an inserted __TRILIUM_PH_0__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Card__TRILIUM_PH_3__ link preview to select it, and a small toolbar will appear with the following options:
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview

The dialog changes its address, its __TRILIUM_PH_9__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_10__ (especially useful if the title is hidden behind a login screen), the __TRILIUM_PH_11__Description__TRILIUM_PH_12__ of a card and how it is displayed. A new address shows the title and description of the new page, unless you type your own.

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Display__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu, which converts the preview to a normal link that reads as its title (__TRILIUM_PH_2__Text__TRILIUM_PH_3__) or switches it to another display mode (__TRILIUM_PH_4__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Card__TRILIUM_PH_7__ or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_9__).

units.source: The Embed option is only shown for a YouTube video or an audio or video file. A __TRILIUM_PH_0__Card__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of a file whose address does not end in a known extension, such as __TRILIUM_PH_2__ or __TRILIUM_PH_3__, no longer offers it.

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu, with __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_8__, __TRILIUM_PH_9__ __TRILIUM_PH_10__Copy address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_11__, the same display modes under __TRILIUM_PH_12__ __TRILIUM_PH_13__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_14__, and __TRILIUM_PH_15__ __TRILIUM_PH_16__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_17__, which replaces the preview with its address as plain text.

units.source: Right-clicking a link preview selects it and opens its __TRILIUM_PH_0__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview

units.source: Audio and video__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: A YouTube video, a video file or an audio file shown as an __TRILIUM_PH_0__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_1__ has a size, a position, a title and a caption, like an __TRILIUM_PH_2__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_3__. A video keeps its shape, so a YouTube Short stands upright and an older video can be 4:3. A YouTube video inserted in an earlier version is 16:9 until it is inserted again. In the editor, a click on the video both plays it and selects it, and so does a later click on the player.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: A video file or an audio file plays in the media player of Trilium, the one of __TRILIUM_PH_0__File__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes, with its play button, seek bar and volume. A video file shows a picture of one of its frames, taken when it is inserted (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Where the preview data comes from__TRILIUM_PH_3__ below), and a __TRILIUM_PH_4__ icon when it has none. An audio file shows a row of controls. When a file cannot be played, a message takes the place of the player, at the size of the video. Under it is the error that the site answered, if any, such as __TRILIUM_PH_5__HTTP 404: Not found__TRILIUM_PH_6__ for a file that is no longer there.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Copy address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Display__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu, which turns the embed into an __TRILIUM_PH_2__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Card__TRILIUM_PH_5__ link preview with its title, or a __TRILIUM_PH_6__Text__TRILIUM_PH_7__ link that reads as its title. The text of its caption stays, as a paragraph after it.

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu:
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Open externally__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the media outside Trilium: in the browser, or in the app that handles the link, such as the YouTube app on Android.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit...__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_4__ dialog with only the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_8__ of the media, as does pressing __TRILIUM_PH_9__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_10__+__TRILIUM_PH_11__K__TRILIUM_PH_12__ while the embed is selected. With another address, the embed plays the new media and keeps its size, position, title and caption. It takes the thumbnail and the shape of the new media, and a video file gets a picture of one of its frames, as when it is inserted. A video at its first size takes the first size of the new video, and an audio file in place of a video, or a video in place of an audio file, takes the size of new media. A new address shows the title of the new media, unless you type your own. When the address is not that of a YouTube video, an audio or a video file, the embed stays as it was and Trilium shows an error.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Copy address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: The display modes of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Display__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu under __TRILIUM_PH_2__ __TRILIUM_PH_3__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_4__.

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Size__TRILIUM_PH_1__: a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_3__ video can be resized and placed in the text, a __TRILIUM_PH_4__Full__TRILIUM_PH_5__ video takes the width of the note, or less when it would be taller than most of the window, and a __TRILIUM_PH_6__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_7__ video is a row with its title alone. A new video is __TRILIUM_PH_8__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_9__. A YouTube video inserted in an earlier version is __TRILIUM_PH_10__Full__TRILIUM_PH_11__. An audio file is __TRILIUM_PH_12__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_13__, a row of controls, or __TRILIUM_PH_14__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_15__, a box with the controls under the visualizer, whose width can be resized. __TRILIUM_PH_16__Default__TRILIUM_PH_17__ returns the media to the size it was inserted at.

units.source: Right-clicking a video file or an audio file opens the same __TRILIUM_PH_0__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ menu. So does right-clicking a YouTube video, but only until it plays: from then on, the right-click goes to YouTube's player, which shows its own menu.

units.source: To resize a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Resizable__TRILIUM_PH_1__ video or audio file, select it and drag the handle in its bottom-right corner, or its bottom-left corner for one aligned to the right. The height of a video follows the width. __TRILIUM_PH_2__Default__TRILIUM_PH_3__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Size__TRILIUM_PH_5__ submenu returns a video to its first size.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared page__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the media keeps its width, position and caption, but not its title. A video or audio file plays in the browser's own player once the visitor clicks it. In the mobile layout, media with a position other than __TRILIUM_PH_2__Align center__TRILIUM_PH_3__ takes the full width.
units.context: Link Previews > Altering an existing link preview > Audio and video

units.source: Where the preview data comes from__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: When you insert a link preview, Trilium fetches metadata once and stores it with the note:
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__YouTube URLs__TRILIUM_PH_1__: the title, the channel name and the shape of the video are fetched via YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint, and the video's thumbnail is downloaded at up to 1280×720.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Audio and video files__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Trilium reads the start of the file, enough to tell audio from video and, for most MP4 and WebM files, the shape of the video. The rest of the file is not downloaded, and the file is not copied into Trilium. Once a video file is inserted, the editor takes a picture of a frame a few seconds into it as its thumbnail. The frame is read through the Trilium server, so the site of the file sees the server and not your browser. The standalone (browser) and mobile versions have no such server: they read the frame from the site directly, and a video whose site does not let other sites read it has no thumbnail.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__All other URLs__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Trilium fetches the page and reads OpenGraph tags (__TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__, __TRILIUM_PH_5__), falling back to the page's __TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__. The site's favicon and the page's image are downloaded as well.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: The text is kept in the note's HTML. The images are kept as system __TRILIUM_PH_0__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the note, listed under __TRILIUM_PH_2__Generated by Trilium__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: Because the data is stored in the note itself, link previews continue to render correctly when you reopen the note, share/publish it, or export to HTML — without any further network requests.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: The metadata is captured __TRILIUM_PH_0__at insertion time__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and is not automatically refreshed. If the linked page later changes its title or thumbnail, you'll need to re-insert the link to pick up the new values. To refresh a link, simply create it again.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: A YouTube embed inserted before v0.107.0 keeps its smaller thumbnail, shown blurred, until the link is inserted again.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

units.source: When accessing a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Server Installation__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the data is fetched from the remote URL by the server and not the client.
units.context: Link Previews > Where the preview data comes from

The Embed display mode supports YouTube and audio and video files. Pages of other video and media platforms fall back to a Card preview.
External links

An external link is a standard web link targeting for example a website. For example, __TRILIUM_PH_0__https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_China_Sea__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is an external link to a Wikipedia page.
To create a link without a custom text:
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__, or press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__+__TRILIUM_PH_5__K__TRILIUM_PH_6__:

Since v0.107.0, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog opens on __TRILIUM_PH_2__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_3__, in a popup next to the cursor on desktop. Type or paste the address, and optionally a __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_5__; without one, the link shows its address. The __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_8__ button at the end of the address field replaces its text with the text on the clipboard. This button is shown only where Trilium can read the clipboard: in the desktop app, and in a browser over HTTPS unless access to the clipboard was blocked.

When you leave the address field, or paste with the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button, an empty __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_3__ is filled with the title of the web page; a spinner at its end shows while it loads. A title you type is kept. To turn this off, go to __TRILIUM_PH_4__Options__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_7__ and turn off __TRILIUM_PH_8__Automatically retrieve titles for text links__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Features__TRILIUM_PH_11__ section.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_1__ inserts the address as __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or as one of the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_5__: __TRILIUM_PH_6__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__Card__TRILIUM_PH_9__ or, for a YouTube video or the address of an audio or video file, __TRILIUM_PH_10__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_11__.
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to confirm.

Alternatively, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and choose __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link to a web page__TRILIUM_PH_3__, which opens the same dialog. __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link to a web page (with icon)__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Link to a web page (as a card)__TRILIUM_PH_7__ open it with that display already picked.
A simpler way is to paste the raw link and press space to turn it automatically into a link.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button and __TRILIUM_PH_1__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_2__+__TRILIUM_PH_3__L__TRILIUM_PH_4__ of __TRILIUM_PH_5__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_6__ open the same dialog on __TRILIUM_PH_7__Note__TRILIUM_PH_8__. Select __TRILIUM_PH_9__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_10__ at the top of the dialog to create an external link from there.

An address without a scheme, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__, gets __TRILIUM_PH_1__. The dialog does not insert an address that is not a valid URL, or a __TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__ link, since those can run code, and shows the reason under the address field. A URL pasted into the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Note__TRILIUM_PH_6__ field, or picked from its search, switches the dialog to __TRILIUM_PH_7__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_8__. The dialog also opens on __TRILIUM_PH_9__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_10__ when the selected text is a URL.
To create a link with a custom text:
First, type and select the text which will be turned into a link.

Open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog as above (via the formatting toolbar, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__K__TRILIUM_PH_5__). The selected text becomes the text of the link, so the dialog does not offer __TRILIUM_PH_6__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
Alternatively, simply paste (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__) over the selected text to turn it into a link.
Once a link is inserted:
The text inside the link can be changed if needed but the link itself will remain.

To modify the link, click on the link to display the popup and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button. It opens the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_4__ dialog, filled with the link's address and text, as do placing the cursor inside the link and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_6__+__TRILIUM_PH_7__K__TRILIUM_PH_8__, __TRILIUM_PH_9__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_10__+__TRILIUM_PH_11__L__TRILIUM_PH_12__ or one of the link buttons. __TRILIUM_PH_13__Save link__TRILIUM_PH_14__ changes the whole link, its text included, and the dialog can also turn it into a link to a note.

To remove a link, click on it, open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu at the end of the popup and choose __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_5__. The text stays, without the link.

The same menu has __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Copy address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_5__, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_7__, which turns the link into one of the __TRILIUM_PH_8__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_9__, as does the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Display__TRILIUM_PH_11__ menu of the popup.
Right-clicking a link opens the same menu.

To follow an external link in a note being edited, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click or double-click it, which opens it in a new tab or window, place the cursor in it and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__, or right-click it and choose __TRILIUM_PH_6__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_7__. On a touch device, touch and hold the link, then choose __TRILIUM_PH_8__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_9__. A link in an __TRILIUM_PH_10__included note__TRILIUM_PH_11__ that is not __TRILIUM_PH_12__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_13__ opens on a click, as in a read-only note.
Internal (reference) links
Internal links are links to other notes within Trilium.
You can open an internal link by clicking it. You can also see a read-only preview of an internal link's contents by hovering over it.
Since v0.107.0, clicking an internal link while editing a text note shows its popup instead, as clicking an external link does:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ opens the linked note, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open attachment__TRILIUM_PH_3__ for a link to an attachment. A link into the same note reads __TRILIUM_PH_4__Jump to heading__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Jump to block__TRILIUM_PH_7__ or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Jump to anchor__TRILIUM_PH_9__ instead, and scrolls to it without leaving the note.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Download__TRILIUM_PH_2__, for a link to an attachment, downloads the attachment.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ changes the link, as described below.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu, with __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_5__ first, which does what the first button does, then __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Open note in a new tab__TRILIUM_PH_8__, __TRILIUM_PH_9__ __TRILIUM_PH_10__Open note in a new split__TRILIUM_PH_11__, __TRILIUM_PH_12__ __TRILIUM_PH_13__Open note in a new window__TRILIUM_PH_14__ and __TRILIUM_PH_15__ __TRILIUM_PH_16__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_17__, then __TRILIUM_PH_18__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_19__ and __TRILIUM_PH_20__ __TRILIUM_PH_21__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_22__, which turns the link into plain text. A link that shows the title of the note ends with __TRILIUM_PH_23__Convert link to an included note__TRILIUM_PH_24__, described in __TRILIUM_PH_25__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_26__. A link to an attachment lists the actions on the attachment between __TRILIUM_PH_27__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_28__ and __TRILIUM_PH_29__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_30__, except __TRILIUM_PH_31__ __TRILIUM_PH_32__Delete attachment...__TRILIUM_PH_33__, which follows __TRILIUM_PH_34__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_35__, and ends with converting the attachment into a note. A link to blocks of the same note leaves out the ways to open the note elsewhere.
In a note being edited, right-clicking a link also opens this menu.

To follow the link without the popup, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click or double-click it, which does what the first button of the popup does, or place the cursor in it and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__. On a touch device, touch and hold the link, then choose the first entry of its menu, such as __TRILIUM_PH_6__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_7__ or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Jump to heading__TRILIUM_PH_9__. To open the note in a new tab, click it with the middle mouse button. The preview does not show while the popup is open.
A link in an __TRILIUM_PH_0__included note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ that is not __TRILIUM_PH_2__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_3__ opens on a click, as in a read-only note.
Inserting internal links__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Internal links can be created at the current position in a text note by:

Pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__L__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ button underneath the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ menu in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_7__, or by choosing __TRILIUM_PH_8__Link to a note (internal link)__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_11__. On desktop, the __TRILIUM_PH_12__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_13__ dialog opens in a popup next to the cursor.

Searching for the title of the desired note to link. It's also possible to create new notes from this dialog by typing a non-existing note title and selecting either __TRILIUM_PH_0__Create note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which places it in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note Inbox__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (today's day note, or the top level, when no inbox is set), or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_5__, which places it under the note being edited.
There are two link types, depending on the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ field of the dialog:
When the link title is not set, the link will display the title of the note. If the title of the note gets changed, the link will be renamed automatically to the new name.
This is sometimes also called "reference link".
The icon of the linked note will also be displayed.

If the linked note is deleted, the link keeps the last title it showed, in red and with a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ icon instead of the note icon. Clicking it while editing opens the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Fix link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ dialog, which searches for that title; picking a note, or creating a new one, replaces the link with one to that note.
When a link title is typed, the link shows that text instead.
This will create a traditional hyperlink, where the text of the link can be different from the note title.

Since v0.107.0, to change a link, click it and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button in its popup. For a link with a title of its own, placing the cursor inside it and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__ + __TRILIUM_PH_5__L__TRILIUM_PH_6__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_7__ button works too. The __TRILIUM_PH_8__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_9__ dialog opens on the linked note, with its anchor and, for a link with a title of its own, the link's text; __TRILIUM_PH_10__Save link__TRILIUM_PH_11__ changes the whole link. Emptying the __TRILIUM_PH_12__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_13__ there turns the link into one that displays the title of the note, and typing one gives it a title of its own. For a link to an attachment, the dialog shows only the __TRILIUM_PH_14__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_15__, and emptying it makes the link display the title of the attachment.
In-place linking__TRILIUM_PH_0__
You can also insert internal links “inline” by using the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ symbol:
Type __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in a text note, which will open the note search menu.

Search for the desired note's title by typing a few characters. Use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Up__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Down__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to select the correct note, and press __TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to create the link. It's also possible to create new notes with this method by typing a non-existing note title and selecting __TRILIUM_PH_8__Create note__TRILIUM_PH_9__, as described above, or __TRILIUM_PH_10__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_11__. __TRILIUM_PH_12__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_13__ creates the note under the note being edited without asking for its type, inserts the link and opens the new note in __TRILIUM_PH_14__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_15__, which offers the note types to turn it into while it is still empty.
To create an empty child note and link to it before naming it, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__New child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, described in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert buttons__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Pasting internal links__TRILIUM_PH_0__
You can also insert internal links by copying a note from the note tree.
In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__, select a note and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__C__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
In a text note, paste the link by pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
A note is listed once per reference it makes, so a note that links to the current one three times occupies three rows.
Of note:
For AI chat notes, only the assistant's own prose is quoted. A chat that reached the note purely through tool calls has nothing to quote and is listed by relation name instead.
Excerpts are only generated for roughly the first 50 sources. On a heavily referenced note, the remaining entries fall back to showing the relation name.
Where backlinks are shown__TRILIUM_PH_0__
In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Connections tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_3__, as a dedicated section.

As a badge in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Status bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ showing the number of backlinks. The badge only appears when the note is being read normally (not in a revision or attachment view) and when there is at least one backlink; pressing it opens the section above.

In __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__, as a button with a link icon in the header of the popup, under the same conditions; its tooltip gives the number of backlinks. Pressing a backlink opens that note in the popup.
Incoming links are also drawn on the link map, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map (Link map, Tree map)__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
Lists
There are three types of lists supported by text notes:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ Bulleted lists (also known as unordered lists).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ Numbered lists (or ordered lists).
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ To-do lists

For bulleted and numbered lists, it's possible to configure an alternative marker such as squares or Roman numbering by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ icon. For numbered lists, it's also possible to specify the number to start at or whether to count in reverse order. On the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_2__, these are in the row of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__List ›__TRILIUM_PH_4__ button, which shows while the cursor is in a list; its __TRILIUM_PH_5__List type__TRILIUM_PH_6__ button also turns the list into another kind, to-do lists included.

To create a new list:

Math Equations

Within text notes, it's possible to enter mathematical equations using the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button from the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__ (generally found under the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert buttons__TRILIUM_PH_4__).

By default, the math dialog includes a MathLive visual editor and a TeX field. Disable __TRILIUM_PH_0__MathLive visual editor__TRILIUM_PH_1__ under Options → Text Notes → Features to use only the TeX field and preview.
To make the fields bigger, drag the bottom-right corner of the dialog: the MathLive editor and the TeX field grow with it.

Enabling __TRILIUM_PH_0__Display mode__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will render the equation slightly bigger (especially if using big operators such as summation, or fractions) and center it. Display mode equations will act as blocks (i.e. like paragraphs, or tables) and can be inserted for example in lists. Non-display equations can be part of the text.
Keyboard shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_0__

If inserting equations frequently, using the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__M__TRILIUM_PH_3__ keyboard shortcut can be more comfortable. Alternatively, type __TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__ to trigger the popup directly.
There is currently no quick way to turn an already typed-out equation, such as surrounding it with __TRILIUM_PH_0__ or pressing __TRILIUM_PH_1__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_2__+__TRILIUM_PH_3__M__TRILIUM_PH_4__.
Supported math features__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Technically we are using the KaTeX library which allows for a subset of the TeX format. To see the full list of supported features, consult the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Supported Functions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Support Table__TRILIUM_PH_3__ from the official documentation.
Markdown support__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Math equations will be preserved when exporting to or importing from Markdown, surrounded by __TRILIUM_PH_0__ characters for inline math expressions, and __TRILIUM_PH_1__ for display mode.
If you notice any issue with the Markdown import/export for equations, feel free to __TRILIUM_PH_0__report__TRILIUM_PH_1__ it while providing the equation that causes issues.
Formatting the equation__TRILIUM_PH_0__

It is possible to customize the font size and foreground color for both inline and display-mode equations, just like any other text. For inline equations, the background color/highlight can also be adjusted.

Multicolumn layout
A multicolumn layout arranges content in two to four columns, side by side. A column can hold any kind of content, including tables, images and another multicolumn layout.
Inserting a layout__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Its submenu offers __TRILIUM_PH_5__2 columns__TRILIUM_PH_6__, __TRILIUM_PH_7__3 columns__TRILIUM_PH_8__ and __TRILIUM_PH_9__4 columns__TRILIUM_PH_10__.

Alternatively, type __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and choose __TRILIUM_PH_1__2 columns layout__TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__3 columns layout__TRILIUM_PH_4__ or __TRILIUM_PH_5__4 columns layout__TRILIUM_PH_6__, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_7__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_8__.
The columns of a new layout have equal widths. If text is selected when the layout is inserted, the selection moves into the first column.

units.source: Sorting

Sorting the selection is experimental, and it changes as it matures. To use it, turn on __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sort selection in text editor__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Options__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Experimental Options__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
Trilium can sort the items of a list, a group of paragraphs or the rows of a table in a text note, comparing numbers, dates and times by their value.
Sorting__TRILIUM_PH_0__

To sort, place the cursor in a list or a table, or select the paragraphs to sort, then press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Sort__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_4__ to sort in ascending order. The arrow beside it offers __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ascending__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__Descending__TRILIUM_PH_8__. With the floating toolbar, the button is in the block-level popup.

When the selection covers several paragraphs, list items or table cells, the same choices are also in a submenu of the menu of the block handle (the sequence of dots to the left of the block), just above __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and in the right-click menu of the selection. The submenu is named after what it sorts: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Sort blocks__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Sort list items__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__Sort rows__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the button is in the main row of the toolbar and in the row of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__List ›__TRILIUM_PH_3__ button.
A sort can be undone with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Z__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
What is sorted__TRILIUM_PH_0__

__TRILIUM_PH_0__List items__TRILIUM_PH_1__: with the cursor in a list, the items at its level are sorted. Nested items move with the item they belong to and keep their own order. To sort only some of the items, select them.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Paragraphs and other blocks__TRILIUM_PH_1__: select two or more paragraphs, headings, quotes, collapsible blocks or images. Each block is sorted by its first text: a collapsible block by its title, a quote by its first paragraph and an image by its caption. A selection that mixes a list with other blocks cannot be sorted.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Table rows__TRILIUM_PH_1__: the rows are sorted by the column of the cursor, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Sorting rows__TRILIUM_PH_3__ in __TRILIUM_PH_4__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_5__. Inside a table cell, a list or several selected paragraphs are sorted instead of the rows.
Values are compared the same way as table rows, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__How values are compared__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
Limitations__TRILIUM_PH_0__

The lines of a code block, or of a paragraph split with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__, are not sorted one by one. A __TRILIUM_PH_4__Code__TRILIUM_PH_5__ note can sort its lines, see __TRILIUM_PH_6__Transforming text__TRILIUM_PH_7__ there.
Tables
Tables are a powerful feature for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes, since editing them is generally easy.
To create a table, simply press the table button and select with the mouse the desired amount of columns and rows, as indicated in the adjacent figure.
Since v0.107.0, the same menu starts with an __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert table…__TRILIUM_PH_1__ item, for a table larger than the grid or to type its size instead:
Click the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button and select __TRILIUM_PH_1__Insert table…__TRILIUM_PH_2__. A small form opens at the cursor.

Enter the number of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Columns__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (up to 100) and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Rows__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (up to 1000). The table can have at most 5000 cells in total, for example 1000 rows of 5 columns.

Optionally, turn on __TRILIUM_PH_0__Use headers__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and enter the number of __TRILIUM_PH_2__Header columns__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Header rows__TRILIUM_PH_5__. A table cannot have more header columns or rows than it has columns or rows.
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

To close the form without inserting a table, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Esc__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or click outside it. From the keyboard, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Tab__TRILIUM_PH_3__ moves between __TRILIUM_PH_4__Insert table…__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and the grid while the menu is open.

On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the table is inserted from the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button of the formatting toolbar: its __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert table__TRILIUM_PH_4__ tile lists common sizes, from 2 × 2 to 3 × 4 (rows × columns). Tap one to insert a table of that size; to make it larger, insert rows and columns afterwards.
Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_0__
When a table is selected, a special formatting toolbar will appear:

On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the toolbar does not float over the table. Instead, press the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button after __TRILIUM_PH_3__Undo__TRILIUM_PH_4__ and __TRILIUM_PH_5__Redo__TRILIUM_PH_6__ in the formatting toolbar at the bottom of the screen to show the table's toolbar there.
Context menu__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Since v0.106.0, right-clicking anywhere inside a table opens a context menu with the most common table operations:

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert row above__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert row below__TRILIUM_PH_3__ insert a blank row next to the row of the current cell. When the selection spans multiple rows, the same number of rows is inserted.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert column to the left__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert column to the right__TRILIUM_PH_3__ work the same way for columns.

Since v0.107.0, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Set as header__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Set header up to this row__TRILIUM_PH_3__, depending on the selection, turns rows into header rows, which always start at the top of the table:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Set as header__TRILIUM_PH_1__ shows when the selection starts at the first row, and makes every selected row a header row.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Set header up to this row__TRILIUM_PH_1__ shows when the selection is in a single row below the first, and makes that row and every row above it header rows.
Neither shows when the selection spans several rows below the first.

A check mark shows that the rows are already header rows. Choosing the item again turns them, and every header row below them, back into regular rows. For example, in a table with five header rows, choosing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Set header up to this row__TRILIUM_PH_1__ on the third row leaves only the first two as header rows.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Merge cells__TRILIUM_PH_1__ merges the selected cells into one. The selected cells must form a rectangle.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Split cell__TRILIUM_PH_1__ splits each selected cell in two, either __TRILIUM_PH_2__Vertically__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Horizontally__TRILIUM_PH_5__. __TRILIUM_PH_6__Unmerge cells__TRILIUM_PH_7__, in the same submenu, turns each merged cell in the selection back into the single cells it covers, keeping its content in the top-left one; cells that are not merged stay as they are.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Distribute columns evenly__TRILIUM_PH_1__ splits the combined width of the columns the selection touches equally between them. The other columns and the width of the table stay as they are. It needs a selection spanning at least two columns; a merged cell counts for every column it covers.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Copy as Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_5__ act on the selected cells. Since v0.107.0, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_7__ and __TRILIUM_PH_8__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_9__ open submenus with their variants, such as __TRILIUM_PH_10__Copy as Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_11__ and __TRILIUM_PH_12__Paste as plain text__TRILIUM_PH_13__; clicking __TRILIUM_PH_14__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_15__ or __TRILIUM_PH_16__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_17__ itself still copies or pastes:

Cutting or copying produces a smaller table holding just the selected cells. Pasting it over a cell selection replaces those cells; pasting elsewhere inserts it as a table of its own. Cutting clears the cells without removing rows or columns.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Copy as Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_1__ converts the selected cells to a Markdown table. A selected header row becomes the Markdown header; without one, an empty header row is emitted, since Markdown tables require one.

Since v0.107.0, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste rows above__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Paste rows below__TRILIUM_PH_3__, in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_5__ submenu, paste the clipboard as new rows next to the row of the current cell, instead of over the cells from the cursor on. They show only when the selection is in a single row, and, like __TRILIUM_PH_6__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_7__, only where the clipboard can be read:

A copied table becomes one new row for each of its rows, filled from the first column. When it has more columns than the table, the table gains columns, as with a regular paste. Other content goes in the first cell of a single new row.
The new rows are selected afterwards.
When merged cells join the row to others, the new rows go above or below that whole block of rows.
Using touch:
Since v0.107.0, touching a table outlines the cell with the cursor, or the selected cells, and shows a handle at each corner of the outline.

To select multiple cells, drag one of the handles across the table. The cell at the opposite corner stays selected, so the selection grows or shrinks as the finger moves. The note and wide tables scroll when the handle reaches the edge of the screen.
Resizing cells__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Columns can be resized by hovering the mouse over the border of two adjacent cells and dragging it.

To give several columns the same width, select cells across them and choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__Distribute columns evenly__TRILIUM_PH_1__ from the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button of the formatting toolbar or from the __TRILIUM_PH_3__context menu__TRILIUM_PH_4__.
By default, the row height is not adjustable using the mouse, but it can be configured from the cell settings (see below).
To adjust exactly the width (in pixels or percentages) of a cell, select the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button.
Resizing with touch__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: Since v0.107.0, touching a table shows a bar at the bottom of the note, above the formatting toolbar on mobile. The bar has a segment for each column of the table, with a divider at the end of each column. Only the divider of the column with the cursor is a handle that resizes; the other dividers only mark where the columns meet, so a swipe across them scrolls instead. When several cells are selected, each column they cover has a handle.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: To resize a column, place the cursor in one of its cells or tap its segment, then drag its handle. The table grows or shrinks with the column, and scrolls when the handle reaches the edge of the screen. The column snaps to its starting width and to the widths of the columns beside it.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: To cancel a resize, drag the handle back to where it started, or touch the screen with a second finger.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: To give a column and the next one the same width, double-tap the handle between them.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: To select a column, tap its segment. To open the column menu, touch and hold the segment.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: To scroll a wide table sideways, swipe along the bar.
units.context: Tables > Resizing cells > Resizing with touch

units.source: A wide table scrolls a little past its end, so the handle of its last column stays away from the edge of the screen, where a swipe navigates back.

units.source: Wide tables__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Since v0.107.0, a table can be wider than the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Content width__TRILIUM_PH_1__. Such a table scrolls sideways, while the rest of the note keeps its width.

A new table is as wide as the content. To make it wider, drag the right border of its last column past the edge of the content. The border snaps to the edge and holds there briefly, so the table is easy to bring back to the width of the content.
To set an exact width, enter a percentage above __TRILIUM_PH_0__ or a width in pixels in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__ __TRILIUM_PH_2__table properties__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
A table whose content needs more room than the note, such as a pasted table with many columns, also scrolls instead of stretching the note.
Wide tables scroll the same way in read-only notes and on shared pages.
When printing or exporting to PDF, a wide table is shrunk to fit the page.
Tables inside other blocks, such as block quotes, admonitions, collapsible blocks, columns or tabs, are limited to the width of their block and do not scroll.
Mobile support__TRILIUM_PH_0__

On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, a table keeps the width it has on a desktop and scrolls sideways, instead of squeezing its columns into the width of the screen. The full width of a table is the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Max content width__TRILIUM_PH_3__ set in __TRILIUM_PH_4__Options__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Appearance__TRILIUM_PH_7__ → __TRILIUM_PH_8__Content Width__TRILIUM_PH_9__ on the mobile device, 1200 pixels by default. For example, a table set to __TRILIUM_PH_10__ is 600 pixels wide.
To resize columns on mobile, use the bar described in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Resizing with touch__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
Long tables__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Since v0.107.0, the header rows of a table stay visible at the top of the note while you scroll through the rest of the table, and leave with the end of the table. This also works in read-only notes, on shared pages and in wide tables.

To turn rows into header rows, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Set as header__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__context menu__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Header row__TRILIUM_PH_5__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__ button of the formatting toolbar.

To let header rows scroll away with the rest of the table, turn off __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Features__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Use sticky header rows for tables__TRILIUM_PH_7__. The setting applies to the current device only, and shared pages keep their sticky header rows.
Inserting new rows and new columns__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Whatever follows the number, such as a unit, is ignored, so units are not converted: __TRILIUM_PH_3__ sorts before __TRILIUM_PH_4__. A cell that starts with letters, such as __TRILIUM_PH_5__, is text.

A comma or period that is not followed by exactly three digits is always read as a decimal separator, so __TRILIUM_PH_1__ is one and a half in either language.

units.source: Merged cells__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Rows joined by a merged cell are kept together and move as one block. The block is sorted by the value in its first row. When the block has more than one cell in the sorted column, the other cells do not affect the order, and a message says so: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Some rows were sorted together because merged cells tie them to each other__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
When the selection covers only part of such a block, the whole block is sorted.
Merging cells__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Cell properties__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Similarly to table properties, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button opens a popup which adjusts the styling of one or more cells (based on the user's selection).
The following options can be adjusted:
The border style, color and width (same as table properties), but applying to the current cell only.
The background color, with none set by default.
The width and height of the cell in percentage (must end with __TRILIUM_PH_0__) or pixels (must end with __TRILIUM_PH_1__).
The padding (the distance of the text compared to the cell's borders).
The alignment of the text, both horizontally (left, centered, right, justified) and vertically (top, middle or bottom).
In a centered or right-aligned cell, each item of a bulleted, numbered or to-do list moves together with its bullet, number or checkbox.
The cell will immediately update to reflect the changes, but the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Save__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button must be pressed for the changes to persist.
Border and background colors__TRILIUM_PH_0__

The border and background colors of tables and cells adapt to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__theme__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the same way as __TRILIUM_PH_2__text colors__TRILIUM_PH_3__ do. A color picked from the palette, chosen with the color picker or typed in is shown in a lighter or darker shade that suits the current theme, so borders stay visible and text stays readable on the background. The hue stays the same, and the table keeps the color as it was picked.
Colors applied with older versions of Trilium are shown exactly as they were picked, until the note is next edited.
Older browsers that can't adapt colors show them exactly as they were picked.

Header cells are shaded to suit the current theme. To change their background in every table, set the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ variable in a __TRILIUM_PH_1__custom theme__TRILIUM_PH_2__ or in __TRILIUM_PH_3__custom app-wide CSS__TRILIUM_PH_4__, for example __TRILIUM_PH_5__. A background picked for a cell still takes precedence.
Caption__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button to insert a caption or a text description of the table, which is going to be displayed above the table.
Table borders__TRILIUM_PH_0__
By default, tables come with a gray border that is lighter or darker to suit the current __TRILIUM_PH_0__theme__TRILIUM_PH_1__, so it stays discreet on a dark background.

To change the default border of every table, set the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ variable in a __TRILIUM_PH_1__custom theme__TRILIUM_PH_2__ or in __TRILIUM_PH_3__custom app-wide CSS__TRILIUM_PH_4__, for example __TRILIUM_PH_5__. Set it to __TRILIUM_PH_6__ to hide the borders of all the tables that don't have a border of their own.
To adjust the borders, follow these steps:
Select the table.
In the floating panel, select the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Table properties__TRILIUM_PH_1__ option (__TRILIUM_PH_2__).
Look for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Border__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section at the top of the newly opened panel.
This will control the outer borders of the table.
Select a style for the border. Generally __TRILIUM_PH_0__Single__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is the desirable option.
Select a color for the border.
